title: The revolution of Rienzi
html_source: Cola di Rienzi (1313-1350) was an Italian populist figure who fomented popular rebellion, leading a successful revolt against the nobility and installing himself as Roman Tribune. He was immortalized in Bulwer-Lytton’s novel “Rienzi, The Last of the Tribunes” and perhaps more famously in the Wagner opera it inspired, “Rienzi, der letzte der Tribunen”.
